title: Short pants and curfew for boys
summary: Ernie and Dejan recall that boys wore short pants until their late teens, police sent them home, and boys were not considered men until twenty.

story.theme_name: Growing up and learning music: family, first instruments, teachers
story.community_name: Where I came from: parents, siblings and birth

blocks.x: And how old did you have to be before you could stay out at the nines?
Oh, as a matter of fact, I was about 11, 12 years old. Now you're the best I'd make it in.

You see, you stood in short pants a long time. That's right. You stood in short pants until 18 years old, I think. As a matter of fact, the police used to run you in long ways. But if you had a short pants on, the police would rush you to get off the street. Sometimes they'd bring you home, sometimes they'd bring you back, people had to go get you. It's like that. But if you had long pants on, the police would stop you right on. It wasn't like it is now. You know, sharing 14 years old stay out at the street later than me. You was a child, you was a child. That was it.

See, you wasn't considered to be no man until you was 20. And you'd be boys, man, taller than you, man. They'd come in the dance. You didn't tell me, man, I'm only 18 years old. I can't get in there. They'd have them dows, pants, ripped stockings on like that. Dress stuff. When the police said, well, by the morning, I want to see you in long pants. You were a man. You had to get in long pants. By naturally, you get in long pants. You got to go get him a job.

Don't worry. See them tunnel pushers, them girls? That was the straight legs come right below the knee. They used to wear pants like that too. That was a style. That was a tailor-made. Boys wear the tailor-made clothes wore their pants come right below the knee like that. I mean straight. With the button on it, right? Just like a fella foot.
But we wore them as blouse over your knee, you know?
They wore that up to around 1923, 24, like that. Right around here.
